description: Cluster contacting binder residues into hydrophobic patches at a chain interface.

atom_dim.title: 原子维度
atom_dim.description: Dim name of the structure form's atom axis.

field_dim.title: 字段维度
field_dim.description: Dim name of the structure form's field axis.

patch_dim.title: 斑块维度
patch_dim.description: Dim name assigned to the patch axis on the output form.

binder_chains.title: Binder 链
binder_chains.description: Comma separated chains whose contacting residues are clustered.

target_chains.title: Target 链
target_chains.description: Comma separated target chains. Leave empty to use every remaining chain.

cutoff.title: 接触距离 (Å)
cutoff.description: Heavy-atom distance below which a binder residue contacts the target.

ca_cutoff.title: 聚类距离 (Å)
ca_cutoff.description: Single-linkage distance between residue anchors that joins two patches.

min_residues.title: 最小残基数
min_residues.description: Discard patches with fewer residues than this.

hydrophobic_resnames.title: 疏水残基
hydrophobic_resnames.description: Comma separated residue names counted as hydrophobic.

exclude_resnames.title: 排除残基
exclude_resnames.description: Comma separated residue names ignored before computing contacts.

output.title: 输出名称
output.description: Form name registered in the execution context.
